identity: Walking gait. Per animation group: swing amplitude in degrees about the body's pivot for that group, a phase offset (fraction of the cycle), an optional `pivot` override, and an optional `parent` group whose swing is inherited first. Legs swing opposite each other; each arm swings counter to the leg on its own side; each foot adds a small ankle flex on top of its leg's swing; the torso bobs at twice the stride frequency.
